This change is preventing the error, but is also preventing the early return,

In theory it just attempts to make a change in `wd.flags` and results in the same value, but i have not idea if accessing the member produces any side effect.

If eventually any code like emitting a signal is added after this, this condition would not prevent the emission of that theoretical signal

Hi. If it were for me I'd have implemented an early return up above, before the `switch` block but, since the X11 backend does the same thing I preferred to keep errors consistent between both.

BTW don't worry about the member, it's a plain `uint32_t`, there are no fancy hidden semantics.

If we'll ever add signals, we'll worry about that then, [it's a best practice to not worry about hypothetical issues](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/contributing/development/best_practices_for_engine_contributors.html#to-solve-the-problem-it-has-to-exist-in-the-first-place) ;)
yea, I noticed it too but since every other platform had it I just kept it for consistency :P
